title: Figure 14: Experimentally measured squeezed state (noise dB vs phase)
description: Line graph of Φ(Ω,θ) in dB from -6 to 12 versus relative phase angle, marked θ₋ and θ₋+π, comparing a squeezed state trace (I) with large oscillations and deep negative valleys against a flat vacuum trace (II). Caption reads "Figure 14. Experimentally Measured Squeezed State. (courtesy of P. Marecki)" and explains that the deep valleys are sub-vacuum regions with negative energy density.
